title: RSD-1 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-1 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district intended for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right; two-family and multi-family dwellings are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 10,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 75 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 35%; minimum front setback 35 ft; minimum rear yard depth 30 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSD-2 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-2 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 7,800 sq ft; minimum lot width 65 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 35%; minimum front setback 35 ft; minimum rear yard depth 30 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSD-3 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-3 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 5,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 30%; minimum front setback 25 ft; minimum rear yard depth 25 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-1 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-1 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district for attached and semi-detached houses on individual lots. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 5,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 30%; minimum front setback 25 ft; minimum rear yard depth 25 ft; corner side yard 7 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-2 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-2 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 3,150 sq ft; minimum lot width 35 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 40%; minimum front setback 15 ft; minimum rear yard depth 20 ft; corner side yard 6 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-3 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-3 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 2,250 sq ft; minimum lot width 25 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 8 ft; minimum rear yard depth 15 ft (single-family); corner side yard 8 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-4 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-4 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district that also allows attached (rowhouse) building types. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 1,620 sq ft; minimum lot width 18 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 15 ft; minimum rear yard depth 20 ft (single-family); corner side yard 6 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-5 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-5 is the most common Residential Single-Family Attached (rowhouse) district, for attached and semi-detached houses on individual lots. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot width 16 ft; minimum lot area 1,440 sq ft, or 960 sq ft in Council Districts 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7; a lot of at least 1,600 sq ft may be subdivided into lots as small as 800 sq ft under stated conditions. Maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 9 ft; side yard 5 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RTA-1 — Residential Two-Family Attached
text: RTA-1 is a Residential Two-Family Attached district for two-family and semi-detached houses on individual lots. Single-family and two-family dwellings are permitted by right; multi-family is prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 2,250 sq ft; minimum lot width 25 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 8 ft; minimum rear yard depth 15 ft (single-family); corner side yard 8 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RTA-2 — Residential Two-Family Attached
text: RTA-2 is a Residential Two-Family Attached district. Single-family and two-family dwellings are permitted by right; multi-family is prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 1,080 sq ft; minimum lot width 16 ft; maximum height 35 ft (maximum three stories); maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 7 ft; side yard 5 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RM-1 — Residential Multi-Family
text: RM-1 is a Residential Multi-Family district intended for moderate- to high-density, multi-unit residential buildings. Single-family, two-family, and multi-family dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum lot area 1,440 sq ft; minimum lot width 16 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 9 ft; side yard 5 to 12 ft based on number of families. Dwelling-unit density: at least 360 sq ft of lot area per dwelling unit for the first 1,440 sq ft, then at least 480 sq ft per unit above 1,440 sq ft, so by-right unit count scales with lot size. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-1 — Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-1 is a Commercial Mixed-Use district for neighborhood-serving retail and service uses along pedestrian-friendly corridors. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and neighborhood commercial uses are permitted. Per Table 14-701-3, CMX-1 occupied area, building dimensions, and height are governed by the most restrictive adjacent residential zoning district to match neighborhood surroundings; there is no independent minimum lot area. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-2 — Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-2 is a Commercial Mixed-Use district for neighborhood-serving retail and services. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): no minimum lot area; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard the greater of 9 ft or 10% of lot depth; side yard 5 ft if used. Residential density is set by lot size and council district (about 480 sq ft of lot area per dwelling unit). Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-2.5 — Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-2.5 is a Commercial Mixed-Use district like CMX-2 but with greater height. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): no minimum lot area; maximum height 55 ft; minimum cornice height 25 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); rear yard greater of 9 ft or 10% of lot depth; side yard 5 ft if used. Density: 360 sq ft per unit below 45 ft of height, 270 sq ft per unit above 45 ft. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-3 — Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-3 is a Commercial Mixed-Use district for community- and region-serving mixed-use development. Two-family and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted by right; single-family is not. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): no minimum lot area; height governed by a maximum floor area ratio of 500% (plus bonuses) rather than a fixed cap; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); side yard 8 ft if the building contains dwelling units. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-4 — Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-4 is a Commercial Mixed-Use district for community- and region-serving mixed-use development. Multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted by right; single- and two-family are not. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): no minimum lot area; height governed by a 500% floor area ratio (plus bonuses); maximum occupied area 90% for buildings of five or fewer stories with dwelling units, otherwise 100%; side yard 5 ft for buildings of four or fewer stories with three or fewer dwelling units, otherwise 8 ft. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CMX-5 — Center City Commercial Mixed-Use
text: CMX-5 is the Center City core Commercial Mixed-Use district for high-density mixed-use development. Multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): no minimum lot area; height governed by a 1200% floor area ratio (1600% for certain lots in the Center City/University City area), plus bonuses; maximum occupied area 90% for buildings of five or fewer stories with dwelling units, otherwise 100%; side yard 5 to 8 ft if used. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CA-1 — Auto-Oriented Commercial
text: CA-1 is an Auto-Oriented Commercial district for shopping-center and destination-oriented commercial uses; dwellings are not permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): minimum lot area 5,000 sq ft; minimum street frontage 50 ft; maximum occupied area 60%; maximum height 38 ft; minimum side and rear yards 5 ft if used. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: CA-2 — Auto-Oriented Commercial
text: CA-2 is an Auto-Oriented Commercial district for larger-scale shopping centers; dwellings are not permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-3): minimum district area 80,000 sq ft; minimum lot area 15,000 sq ft; minimum street frontage 100 ft; maximum occupied area 100%; maximum height 38 ft. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RMX-1 — Residential Mixed-Use
text: RMX-1 is a Residential Mixed-Use district for residential and mixed-use master-plan development. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2) are master-plan based: minimum district area 2 acres; minimum street frontage 50 ft; maximum occupied area 50% (75% where historic structures are present); maximum floor area ratio 150% of district area; subject to an approved master plan. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RMX-2 — Residential Mixed-Use
text: RMX-2 is a Residential Mixed-Use district for residential and mixed-use development. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum district area 1 acre; maximum occupied area 75% of district area; maximum floor area ratio 250% of district area; subject to an approved master plan. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RMX-3 — Residential Mixed-Use
text: RMX-3 is a higher-density Residential Mixed-Use district. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings and commercial uses are permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): no minimum lot area; maximum floor area ratio 500%; maximum occupied area 90% for buildings of five or fewer stories with one or more dwelling units, otherwise 100%; minimum front and rear yards 25 ft; side yard 5 to 8 ft if used. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: IRMX — Industrial Residential Mixed-Use
text: IRMX is an Industrial Residential Mixed-Use district for a mix of low-impact industrial, artisan industrial, residential, and neighborhood commercial uses. Multi-family dwellings, commercial, and low-impact/artisan industrial uses are permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum height 60 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum front, side, and rear yards 0 ft except where abutting a residential district; maximum floor area ratio 500%. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: ICMX — Industrial Commercial Mixed-Use
text: ICMX is an Industrial Commercial Mixed-Use district for commercial and low-impact industrial uses; residential dwellings are not permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum height 60 ft; maximum occupied area 100%; minimum front yard 0 ft; minimum side and rear yards 8 ft; maximum floor area ratio 500%. Yards adjacent to a residential district follow the larger of the industrial or residential requirement. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: I-1 — Light Industrial
text: I-1 is a Light Industrial district for low-impact uses including light industrial, fabrication, offices, and research and development; housing is not permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum occupied area 100%; minimum front yard 0 ft; minimum side and rear yards 8 ft if used; maximum height 60 ft where abutting a Residential or SP-PO district, otherwise no height limit; maximum floor area ratio 500%. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: I-2 — Medium Industrial
text: I-2 is a Medium Industrial district for light-to-moderate-impact industrial uses including manufacturing, processing, and distribution; housing is not permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum occupied area 100%; minimum front yard 0 ft; minimum side yard 6 ft and rear yard 8 ft if used; maximum height 60 ft where abutting a Residential or SP-PO district, otherwise no limit; maximum floor area ratio 500%. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: I-3 — Heavy Industrial
text: I-3 is a Heavy Industrial district for intensive, high-impact uses including extractive industries and petroleum processing and storage; housing is not permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum occupied area 100%; minimum front yard 0 ft; minimum side yard 6 to 8 ft and rear yard 8 ft if used; maximum height 60 ft where abutting a Residential or SP-PO district, otherwise no limit; maximum floor area ratio 500%. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: I-P — Port Industrial
text: I-P is a Port Industrial district for marine-related industrial uses such as docks, wharves, piers, and transit sheds; housing is not permitted. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-4): maximum occupied area 100%; minimum front, side, and rear yards 0 ft; maximum height 60 ft where abutting a Residential or SP-PO district, otherwise no limit. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-6 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-6 is the densest Residential Single-Family Attached (rowhouse) district. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 700 sq ft; minimum lot width 14 ft; maximum height 25 ft (38 ft where stated affordability or block-context conditions are met); maximum occupied area 80%; minimum rear yard depth 7 ft; corner side yard 5 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RM-2 — Residential Multi-Family
text: RM-2 is a Residential Multi-Family district for moderate- to high-density multi-unit buildings. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum lot area 15,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; setbacks and height based on building height; height governed by a floor area ratio of 70% of lot area. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RM-3 — Residential Multi-Family
text: RM-3 is a Residential Multi-Family district for higher-density multi-unit buildings. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum lot area 10,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front and rear yards 20 ft; side yard 6 to 16 ft based on number of families; height governed by a 150% floor area ratio. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RM-4 — Residential Multi-Family
text: RM-4 is the densest Residential Multi-Family district, for high-rise multi-unit buildings. Single-, two-, and multi-family dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum lot area 2,500 sq ft; minimum lot width 20 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); side and rear yards 5 ft if used; height governed by a 350% floor area ratio. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-INS — Special Purpose, Institutional
text: SP-INS is a Special Purpose Institutional district for institutional uses. Development in this district is subject to an approved master plan, so there are no general by-right dimensional standards. Housing (household living) is not permitted by right; institutional, civic, office, and limited commercial uses are allowed. Quick-guide standards (Table 14-602-4): minimum contiguous area 5 acres; maximum gross floor area 400%; maximum occupied area 70%; height generally limited only where adjacent to residential. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-CIV — Special Purpose, Civic, Educational, and Medical
text: SP-CIV is a Special Purpose district for civic, educational, and medical institutional uses. Development in this district is subject to an approved master plan, so there are no general by-right dimensional standards. Housing is not permitted by right. Standards (Table 14-602-4): maximum gross floor area 400%; maximum occupied area 80%; minimum side yard 8 ft if used; minimum rear yard the greater of 9 ft or 10% of lot depth. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-PO-A — Special Purpose, Parks and Open Space
text: SP-PO-A is a Special Purpose Parks and Open Space district that preserves land set aside for park and open-space use. Private residential and most commercial development is prohibited; passive and active recreation and natural-resource preservation are the permitted uses. The size, location, and design of any structures must comply with the dimensional regulations of the most restrictive adjacent zoning district. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-PO-P — Special Purpose, Parks and Open Space
text: SP-PO-P is a Special Purpose Parks and Open Space district for preserved parkland and natural areas. Residential and commercial development is prohibited; natural-resource preservation and passive recreation are the permitted uses. Structures must comply with the dimensional regulations of the most restrictive adjacent zoning district. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-ENT — Special Purpose, Entertainment
text: SP-ENT is a Special Purpose Entertainment district for major entertainment facilities. Development in this district is subject to an approved master plan, so there are no general by-right dimensional standards. Household living and commercial/entertainment uses are permitted. Standards (Table 14-602-4): maximum gross floor area 400% (up to 600% adjacent to SP-STA); minimum open area 10% to 30%; maximum height 300 ft or 30 stories. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-STA — Special Purpose, Sports Stadium
text: SP-STA is a Special Purpose Sports Stadium district for large-scale sporting facilities and associated parking. Development in this district is subject to an approved master plan, so there are no general by-right dimensional standards. Housing is not permitted by right. Standards (Table 14-602-4): minimum setback 300 ft from a residential district (150 ft for parking); maximum height 38 to 150 ft depending on use. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: SP-AIR — Special Purpose, Airport
text: SP-AIR is a Special Purpose Airport district for airport uses and a complementary mix of uses. Housing is not permitted by right; airport-related, commercial, office, and industrial uses are allowed. Standards (Table 14-602-4): maximum gross floor area 500%; maximum occupied area 70%; side yards 6 ft (buildings up to four stories) or 8 ft if used; maximum height varies under the Airport Hazard Control Overlay (§ 14-511). Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.
